proposals.title: SM‑veckan sommar 2026 – Karlstad
proposals.description: The Swedish national championships for winter sports will be held in Karlstad from 23 to 28 June 2026, organised by the Svenska Skidförbundet.
proposals.context: The event will feature 30 different sports, including alpine skiing, cross‑country skiing, ski jumping and others.

evidence.title: Guide: SM‑veckan vinter 2026 | SVT Sport
evidence.summary: The article states that the summer edition of SM‑veckan will be held in Karlstad from 23 to 28 June 2026.
